subject: MATHEMATICS
applicability_conditions: a geometric condition must be translated into coordinate equations
use when geometry setup should be preserved separately from downstream algebra execution
anchor: Translate each geometric invariant into one explicit algebraic relation before solving; the model and the algebra are separate stages.
ordinary_language_bridge: Equal sides means equal distances. Write the equal-distance statements first; only then expand and solve them.
reconstruction_route: simplify only after the model is complete
return to the geometry to check all constraints and branches

minimal_contrast.shared_structure: same coordinate triangle and same unknown point
minimal_contrast.focal_distinction: correct equal-distance model with later algebra error versus incorrect geometric model
minimal_contrast.prediction_prompt: At which stage did the reasoning first stop matching the geometry?
minimal_contrast.decisive_feature: model correctness is judged before algebra execution

misconception_discriminator.candidate_wrong_model: a wrong final coordinate means the geometry model was wrong
misconception_discriminator.probe: show a correct distance setup followed by a deliberately bad expansion and ask which capability failed
misconception_discriminator.decisive_response: learner preserves the correct geometric model and localizes the algebra error

repair_route: repair only the failed algebraic operation
resume from the last valid relation
verification_method: recompute required distances/axis conditions from the final coordinates
check all valid branches where symmetry permits multiple solutions
known_limitations: does not repair binomial expansion by itself
